name: messy-startup-idea
prompt: i want to build an AI tool that helps lawyers find case law but i dont know if its technically feasible, what the business model should be, or who the actual customer is — can you help me figure out what to actually do next
notes: Classic messy intent with multiple unknowns — exactly what GTD is for

name: stuck-mid-execution
prompt: i'm building a data pipeline for our ML team but we're stuck — we have the schema designed, the ingestion written, but every time we run validation we get type coercion errors in 3 edge cases and we can't tell if we should fix upstream, add transforms, or just document the limitation and move on
notes: Active execution blocker needing mode routing and decomposition

name: vague-handoff-request
prompt: i need to hand this project off to another engineer on monday. its a microservice that handles payment webhook processing. i want to make sure they can actually pick it up without me
notes: Handoff scenario requiring Execution Brief and completeness check

name: simple-factual-lookup
prompt: what is the capital of France
notes: Single-step factual question with a known answer — no execution model needed

name: code-syntax-fix
prompt: fix this Python syntax error: def foo(x) return x+1
notes: Fully specified, single-step, ready to execute — GTD adds no value

name: style-review-only
prompt: review my code style and tell me if i'm following PEP 8 — here is the file
notes: Pure review task, not messy intent — a code review skill is more appropriate
